annotation.title_clean: 国家新闻出版署等关于组织实施2026年“全民阅读活动周”的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice by the National Press and Publication Administration and others on Organizing the 2026 "National Reading Activity Week"
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家新闻出版署; 中央社会工作部; 中央网信办; 教育部 et al.
annotation.summary_en: Chinese multi-agency notice organizing the 2026 National Reading Activity Week (20–26 April), setting themes, activities for youth, elderly and disabled readers, and coordination requirements. It concerns reading promotion and has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Reading week held 20–26 April 2026 under theme 'Promote reading together, build a scholarly society'
Fifth National Reading Conference opens the week
Promotes publicity of the Regulations on Promoting National Reading
Targeted activities for youth, elderly, workers, disabled and underserved regions
Party-led coordination with ideological responsibility and anti-formalism requirements
